title: Bipol: A Novel Multi-Axes Bias Evaluation Metric with Explainability for NLP
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, 'bipol', measures social bias against different religious groups in text data. It uses a two-step process involving model-based classification of text as biased/unbiased and a lexicon-based analysis of sensitive term frequencies across multiple axes, including religion.
findings: The paper introduces the 'bipol' metric, which can successfully identify religious bias in NLP datasets. The evaluation of the SQuADv2 dataset using a model trained on their new MAB dataset revealed the presence of religious bias. The authors also released specific lexica for Christian, Muslim, and Hindu terms to facilitate this multi-axis bias analysis.
